security_audit.summary: Most static shell findings are Markdown code fence false positives, not executable Ruby or shell backtick syntax. The quick start contains a confirmed critical curl-to-shell installer command and a confirmed hardcoded executable download URL. The skill also grants broad infsh CLI execution, which can reach external services and account actions.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to sh.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl-to-shell quick start with manual download, checksum verification, and an explicit user confirmation step before execution.
Narrow allowed tools to the specific infsh apps required for drafting, or require explicit confirmation before any external app run.

remediation.issue: Examples can trigger external services or account actions.
remediation.suggestion: Separate content drafting guidance from search, posting, and media-generation commands, and document what data each command sends.

content.value_statement: Professionals often need concise LinkedIn posts that earn attention without sounding generic. This skill provides hook formulas, mobile formatting, content pillars, and engagement prompts.
actual_capabilities: Drafts LinkedIn posts with hook, body, CTA, and hashtag structure.
Applies hook formulas for contrarian takes, stories, statistics, and list posts.
Formats posts for mobile reading with short lines and clear spacing.
Suggests content pillars for expertise, stories, opinions, process, and curated insights.
Reviews posts against common mistakes such as weak hooks and excessive hashtags.
Provides optional inference.sh examples for research and visual content generation.
limitations: Does not verify current LinkedIn algorithm changes unless paired with live research.
Does not publish directly to LinkedIn from the skill instructions.
Needs user context to create specific stories, opinions, and examples.
External CLI examples require an inference.sh account and user review before use.

use_cases.title: Founder Thought Leadership
use_cases.description: Turn lessons, product updates, or market opinions into concise posts that invite replies from prospects and peers.

use_cases.title: B2B Content Calendar
use_cases.description: Create repeatable post formats across expertise, stories, opinions, and curated insights for a weekly publishing plan.

use_cases.title: Professional Brand Building
use_cases.description: Rewrite career lessons, hiring insights, or project wins into posts that feel specific and easy to scan.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Post
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a single LinkedIn update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post about this topic: [topic]. Use a strong hook, short paragraphs, one clear lesson, and a simple CTA.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite for Engagement
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this LinkedIn draft for stronger engagement: [draft]. Improve the first 210 characters, line breaks, specificity, and final question.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Content Pillar Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create five LinkedIn content pillars for [audience] based on [expertise]. Include example post ideas and the best post type for each pillar.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Launch Sequence
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for a multi-post campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-post LinkedIn launch sequence for [offer]. Mix story, contrarian, list, behind-the-scenes, and curated insight formats. Include CTA goals.

output_examples.input: Topic: lessons from removing scope before a deadline.
output_examples.output: A concise story post that opens with a counterintuitive hook, explains the decision, shows the result, and ends with a question about scope cuts.

output_examples.input: Draft: Excited to announce our new analytics feature.
output_examples.output: A rewritten post that leads with the customer problem, uses short mobile-friendly lines, avoids corporate phrasing, and asks readers what metric they track.

output_examples.input: Audience: engineering managers who want better retrospectives.
output_examples.output: A content pillar plan with posts about team rituals, decision quality, meeting design, failure stories, and practical manager templates.

best_practices: Provide the target audience, point of view, and desired response before drafting.
Review the hook separately because the first two lines drive expansion.
Keep one clear idea per post and ask a specific final question.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for generic motivational posts without a concrete story or lesson.
Do not overuse hashtags, links, or promotional language in the main post.
Do not run external CLI examples without reviewing the command and shared data.

faq.question: What does this skill help me write?
faq.answer: It helps draft, rewrite, and structure LinkedIn posts for professional audiences.

faq.question: Can it create a full content plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create content pillars, post ideas, and repeatable formats for a publishing schedule.

faq.question: Does it post to LinkedIn automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill focuses on writing guidance and does not include direct LinkedIn publishing instructions.

faq.question: Can it research current LinkedIn trends?
faq.answer: It includes optional inference.sh search examples, but users should approve external calls and check current results.

faq.question: Is this useful for personal branding?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps turn experience, opinions, and lessons into readable posts with clear engagement prompts.

faq.question: How should I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Provide audience, topic, draft, and goals. Ask for hooks, formatting, CTA options, or pillar planning.
